//: Difficulty presets (docs/gameplay-overhaul/08-difficulty-and-accessibility.md). Each preset's "challenges" gives every kind of challenge its feel on that difficulty, as bounded adjustments to the mechanic's own numbers (src/systems/challenge/difficulty.js, TUNING). They only reach challenges that opted in: every legacy step plays as it always has. A profile or a challenge can set any of these itself, and can give each difficulty its own limits, retries and costs ("difficulty": { "brutal": { ... } }).

deckhand.label: Deckhand
deckhand.summary: For the story and the crew. Wider timing windows, more slack, gentler costs and easy retries. Challenges can still go wrong.

captain.label: Captain
captain.summary: The voyage as meant. Timing, preparation and nerve all count, failure has a price, and mashing the button won't save you.

brutal.label: Brutal
brutal.summary: For old salts. Tighter windows, fewer second chances and heavier costs. Hard, never unfair: every challenge can be won.
